column1: # derivation: §1.7: a missing ELSE answers NULL, and a NULL condition is not
# taken. r = CASE WHEN a THEN 1 WHEN b THEN 2 END: a TRUE (ids 1 to 3) gives
# 1; a FALSE or NULL with b TRUE (ids 4, 7) gives 2; every other row (ids 5,
# 6, 8, 9) takes no WHEN and answers NULL. The plan spells the missing ELSE
# as an INT64 NULL literal. Types: §8.19, every branch INT64; nullable (§8).
